def test_tokenize_yaml():
    import pytest

    # Basic mapping with all scalar types
    token = tokenize_yaml("name: app\nversion: 2\nratio: 1.5\nenabled: true\nmissing: null\n")
    assert isinstance(token, DictToken)
    assert token.value == {
        "name": "app",
        "version": 2,
        "ratio": 1.5,
        "enabled": True,
        "missing": None,
    }
    # Nested sequence
    token = tokenize_yaml("items:\n  - a\n  - b\n")
    assert isinstance(token["items"], ListToken)
    assert token["items"].value == ["a", "b"]

    # Tokens carry positions into the source string
    token = tokenize_yaml("name: app\n")
    assert token.start == 0
    value = token.value["name"]
    assert token.get_value_token_for_key("name").value == "app"

    # Empty content raises ParseError
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc:
        tokenize_yaml("   \n")
    assert exc.value.code == "no_content"
    assert exc.value.position.line_no == 1

    # Invalid YAML raises ParseError with a position
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc:
        tokenize_yaml("foo: [unclosed\n")
    assert exc.value.code == "parse_error"
    assert exc.value.position.line_no == 1

    # Bytes input works
    token = tokenize_yaml(b"key: value\n")
    assert token.value == {"key": "value"}
```

- `token.value` returns the parsed dict since `DictToken` wraps `loader.construct_mapping` output.

def test_tokenize_yaml():
    import pytest

    # Basic mapping with all scalar types
    token = tokenize_yaml("name: app\nversion: 2\nratio: 1.5\nenabled: true\nmissing: null\n")
    assert isinstance(token, DictToken)
    assert token.value == {
        "name": "app",
        "version": 2,
        "ratio": 1.5,
        "enabled": True,
        "missing": None,
    }
    # Nested sequence
    token = tokenize_yaml("items:\n  - a\n  - b\n")
    assert isinstance(token["items"], ListToken)
    assert token["items"].value == ["a", "b"]

    # Tokens carry positions into the source string
    token = tokenize_yaml("name: app\n")
    assert token.start == 0
    value = token.value["name"]
    assert token.get_value_token_for_key("name").value == "app"

    # Empty content raises ParseError
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc:
        tokenize_yaml("   \n")
    assert exc.value.code == "no_content"
    assert exc.value.position.line_no == 1

    # Invalid YAML raises ParseError with a position
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc:
        tokenize_yaml("foo: [unclosed\n")
    assert exc.value.code == "parse_error"
    assert exc.value.position.line_no == 1

    # Bytes input works
    token = tokenize_yaml(b"key: value\n")
    assert token.value == {"key": "value"}
